physical_batch_trials_2026_10_12.authority: new recorded hardware observation; complete private captures and stopped-run journals retained outside distribution
physical_batch_trials_2026_10_12.scope: Two caller-authorized saved presets; the first combines a scene rename with a connected grid cable, the second renames a scene. Each completed receipt was used for exact original-image undo.
stopped_trials: The first batch stopped during target recall before the second upload or Save: this FM9 retained a selected scene that differed from the second target's saved default. Read-only reconciliation found the first result and the second original; the first receipt-based undo and guarded navigation restored the starting state exactly.

After guarded recall alignment was added, a fresh batch saved both intended results but stopped after the second Reload selected another scene. The second saved result had no completed receipt. A hash-bound original-backup restore recovered its saved image, then the completed first receipt was undone. Fresh reads proved both saved targets and the original selection, loaded/saved context and block status matched the start. The restore helper itself stopped at the same post-Reload scene check after its Save; that negative result remains retained.
physical_batch_trials_2026_10_12.completed_trial: A fresh batch with guarded recall and post-Save Reload scene alignment completed both saved edits. Each saved result was read and verified after Save and Reload, and final batch saved reads matched the observed result hashes. Both completed receipts then passed one-shot undo in reverse order. Fresh independent reads of both targets matched their original wire hashes exactly; the original selection, scene, block status and saved/loaded captures also matched exactly.
limits: Physical scope is this two-target FM9 12.00 saved-edit/undo sequence; other edit fields, routes, models and firmware remain separate qualification work.
No audible output, downstream MIDI receiver behavior, full-capacity saved inventory, or interruption during a transmitted upload or Save was tested.
The two stopped trials do not count as completed batches or as proof of automatic recovery; each was reconciled and explicitly restored before a fresh attempt.

physical_parameter_trial_2026_10_12.scope: One mapped saved Amp Drive word in a caller-authorized preset, followed by completed receipt-bound original-image undo
physical_parameter_trial_2026_10_12.result: The offline plan changed exactly one saved parameter word. Temporary upload, Save, repeated saved reads and Reload passed. The actual saved wire hash was retained in the completed receipt, and its exact-result undo restored the original saved image byte-for-byte.
physical_parameter_trial_2026_10_12.preservation: Fresh independent reads of both observed saved test targets matched their original wire hashes. The original selection, scene, block status and saved/loaded captures matched the starting context after undo.

physical_parameter_and_modifier_trials_2.authority: new recorded hardware observation; complete private captures retained outside distribution
physical_parameter_and_modifier_trials_2.compound_parameter_result: One compound mapped Amp Bass/Mid plan changed exactly two adjacent saved words. Independently decoded saved readback equalled the complete authored body, with only those four intended body bytes changed. Temporary upload, Save, repeated saved reads, Reload and receipt-bound exact original-image undo passed.
physical_parameter_and_modifier_trials_2.initial_modifier_attempt: An existing bound modifier source was changed in a guarded temporary upload. Loaded-image verification stopped before Save because the device zeroed one byte vacated when recompression shortened the stream, while the authored raw image retained the old byte. Independent decoding found the loaded body exactly matched the authored body. Query-only reconciliation found the saved image original and the loaded image different. A guarded same-slot Reload restored the original loaded image; no blind retry or Save occurred.
physical_parameter_and_modifier_trials_2.correction: The shared body writer now clears only bytes vacated between the new and old compressed-stream ends, preserving fixed opaque padding beyond them. A synthetic all-model regression checks that boundary.
physical_parameter_and_modifier_trials_2.completed_modifier_result: A fresh plan for the same existing modifier changed only its source word. Guarded upload, Save, repeated saved reads, Reload and receipt-bound exact original-image undo passed. Independent decoding found only the intended source byte changed in the complete saved body.
physical_parameter_and_modifier_trials_2.preservation: The original selection, scene, saved and loaded context matched exactly after undo. A final read-only full-capacity scan verified all capture files and found all 512 saved wire, raw and decoded-body images byte-identical to an integrity-checked full backup acquired before the test series. A further context read after the scan matched the starting context exactly.
limits: The stopped modifier attempt is not a completed persistent edit; its saved image remained original.
The completed modifier test establishes saved-source-word persistence and preservation for one existing binding, not effective controller response, source-name semantics or modifier curve behavior.
The compound Amp test establishes saved words and preservation, not audible calibration.

Scene Ignore lacked matching off/on hardware witnesses and was not physically edited. Other modifier layouts, model/firmware profiles, uploads interrupted in flight and Save interruption remain unqualified.
